title: Jeff Wadlin
intro: Jeff Wadlin (Libertarian Party) is running for election to the U.S. Senate to represent Arkansas. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on February 22, 2026.
